verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a global cloud and app-hosting platform, so a built-in image CDN with on-demand resizing is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers VMs, Sprites, Postgres, volumes and Anycast networking, but nothing documents image resizing, optimization or an image CDN. A community comment about lacking an S3 replacement does not address image transformation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN
